description: The USDA's world supply and demand estimates (WASDE) for wheat, corn, coarse grains, rice, cotton, soybeans, soybean meal and soybean oil: beginning stocks, production, imports, use, exports and ending stocks by country for the last two market years and this year's projection, with last month's projection beside it and the revision between them. Any month's report, or every country at once. No key.

commodity.description: wheat, corn, coarse grains, rice, cotton, soybeans, soybean meal or soybean oil (world and US); sorghum, barley, oats, feed grains, beef, pork, broilers, turkey, red meat, poultry, eggs or dairy prices (US only).

region.description: A country or region in the USDA's table (China, Brazil, European Union, World...); United States gives the US balance sheet with its farm price; "all" for every country at this month's projection. Default World.

report.description: The report's month, YYYY-MM; default the latest.

name: crop_outlook

outputSchema.description: rows are the balance sheet's lines with one value per market year in the order of columns (this year's projection as last month and this month projected it), and the revision; with region all, one row a country.

title: Crop supply and demand (USDA WASDE)
